title: The Day Has Come!
author: indiegatsu
selftext:
Release day for Bio-Shooter is midnight tonight EST or 9:00PM PST.  

I’m very excited and also very nervous. To my knowledge, it’s the only shooter based game set inside the human body where you can play as either the Germs or the Medicine. 5 maps and 3 game modes (2 night maps for some night ops gameplay), many player cards and titles to unlock, weapons and class skins and ranks.  

I honestly don’t know how release will go! Within the gaming community there seems to be a lot of interest, but i only have 31 wishlist right now. But to me, it’s a very proud 31 as this is my first official indie game. 

I’m also very open with my usage of AI. No need to hide it. updates and patches come way faster. I have a 3 month roadmap already made and ready to go. I’m just hoping an actual community comes to it, so we can make it one of the top indie shooters with a very unique / different idea to it. 

If you have a second, feel free to check it out. I hope to see you all in the fight for the Human Body. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5465060/BioShooter/

Hey u/indiegatsu, this falls under Rule 4. Sharing your game is okay here, free or paid, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.
